assets.name: detector-r4.tar.gz
assets.description: Three trained XLS-R feature heads and the calibrated round-4 detector configuration. This is the current local detector; the frozen XLS-R feature backbone is downloaded separately.

assets.name: editors-v1-v3.tar.gz
assets.description: Frozen experimental editor releases V1, V2, and V3 plus the unchanged default alias. V3 combines trained V1/V2 components with a fixed quality guard. V3 still flags Cartesia on real recordings and is not a reliable remover.

assets.name: research-editors.tar.gz
assets.description: Selected trained spectral/waveform editors, band rebuilders, and explicitly labelled derived variants. Research only; energy budgets vary and some candidates change speech quality. No reliable removal claim or new efficacy validation.

assets.name: research-detectors.tar.gz
assets.description: Earlier trained detector heads, CNN experiments, and WavLM fine-tunes. Superseded research models with different preprocessing and calibration. Use the corresponding source implementation, not the current CLI for every file.

assets.name: research-oracles.tar.gz
assets.description: Fine-tuned XLS-R and AudioSeal-based watermark classifiers used as training teachers. These are classifiers, not audio editors, and are not original Cartesia detector weights. The backbones are upstream models adapted to Cartesia labels.
